verdict.rationale: Raygun docs show native repo integrations (GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab) with source map decoding and a Deployments API requiring an external access token, implying some deployment/version tracking, but there is no explicit documentation of a 'first seen in release' field or automated 'suspect commit' identification tied to an issue. missing for 10: explicit release-tagging of first occurrence, suspect-commit/blame attribution, and any hands-on confirmation this works as described.
